title: Plans to hear music in New York, and modern players taking up Jelly Roll
summary: He hopes to hear modern bands in New York and they discuss Jelly Roll Morton's compositions.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: You mentioned that when you leave here Friday that you won't be sailing until Monday. Monday, Diamond.

Good. I spent a couple of nights in New York, see if I can catch any music. I don't know. I was looking at the New Yorker, but I don't see too much on it. I'd like to hear some of the modern bands, you know, I mean, there's some who are interested in that as well.
You know, I hear that some of the modern, some of the extreme moderns, like I believe Monk is interested in recording Jelly Roll tunes.
I didn't know that. And Jimmy Jufri has made some things, I think he's now playing Santa Claus blues,
Things like that, but with a modern...
Well, Jelly was a great composer, wasn't he?
